mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT oi.product_id FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED')

SELECT p.category_id AS category_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS weight FROM ( SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10 ) o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category_id

SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS weight FROM ( SELECT category_id FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_type = 'VIEW' AND created_at >= #{since} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100 ) recent GROUP BY category_id
